title: Expected product of the $bc$ and $ca$ vote vectors
statement:
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$ be a Boolean function, and for each profile $p:\mathrm{Fin}\,n\to\{0,\dots,5\}$ write $x_{bc}(p),\,x_{ca}(p)\in\{0,1\}^n$ for the $b$-vs-$c$ and $c$-vs-$a$ vote vectors it induces. Then the average of the product $f\bigl(x_{bc}(p)\bigr)\,f\bigl(x_{ca}(p)\bigr)$ over all $6^n$ profiles equals the Fourier correlation function of $f$:
\[
  \Bigl(\tfrac16\Bigr)^{n}\sum_{p} f\bigl(x_{bc}(p)\bigr)\,f\bigl(x_{ca}(p)\bigr)
  \;=\; \mathrm{corr}(f)
  \;=\; \sum_{S\subseteq[n]} \hat f(S)^2\,(-1/3)^{|S|}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: f is a real-valued Boolean function on the n-cube $\{0,1\}^n$
